purpose: Teach: むちゃくちゃ/聴こえ/だまし/気が付か/呟き/めげ/つかまえ/おさえ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お部屋がむちゃくちゃね、お片付けしましょう
lines.en: Sho, your room is quite a mess. Let's tidy it up together, shall we?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, warm instruction. Light on the 'quite a mess' — not scolding, just stating fact. Gentle redirect, like she's done this a hundred times before and will do it a hundred times again.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんの声が聴こえないと寂しいよ
lines.en: Mom… when I can't hear Grandpa's voice, I feel really lonely.
lines.style: Small, careful voice. Hesitant — testing if it's okay to say this. Quiet certainty underneath. Like he's noticed something true and is telling it slowly.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達をだまして遊ぶのはやめましょうね
lines.en: Sho, we don't trick our friends to play with them. Let's stop doing that, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but firm. Not harsh. The tone of someone setting a boundary she needs him to understand. Quiet conviction, no raised voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんの優しさに気が付かなかった事もあったよ
lines.en: Mom… I didn't always notice how kind Grandpa was being.
lines.style: Quiet, almost to himself. Small dawning recognition. Not proud of it, just truthful. Soft, careful pacing — like he's thinking while speaking.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが小さく呟きでお返事されたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father replied with just a small murmur.
lines.style: Observant, tender. She's noticing something quiet. Gentle pace, as if she's seen something her son hasn't yet — something in the small gesture that matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ちょっとやそっとじゃめげないよ
lines.en: Mom… a little bit of trouble won't keep me down.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Not boastful — just steady fact. Small chest, big resolve. Voice stays level, almost matter-of-fact, which makes the stubbornness ring truer.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お庭で蝶々をつかまえる名人ね
lines.en: Sho, you're quite the expert at catching butterflies in the garden.
lines.style: Warmth with genuine pleasure. Light, almost playful tone — she's delighted by this small skill of his. Pride that doesn't embarrass, just notices.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの涙をおさえる仕草を見たよ
lines.en: Mom… I saw Dad holding back his tears.
lines.style: Very soft, very careful. He's sharing something tender he witnessed. No performance — just gentle observation. Slow pace, like he's still processing what he saw.
